![](/content/exams/anzca/2016/B/2/standard-image20.png){fig-alt="Slow response sino-atrial node action potential with phases, threshold and maximum diastolic potential"} ![](/content/exams/anzca/2016/B/2/standard-image21.png){fig-alt="Fast response ventricular action potential with phases, threshold and resting potential"}

+--------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
|                    | **SA Node**                                                                                                           | **Myocyte**                                                    |
+====================+=======================================================================================================================+================================================================+
| **Phase 0**        | Threshold Potential -45mV                                                                                             | Threshold Potential -70mV                                      |
|                    |                                                                                                                       |                                                                |
| **Depolarisation** | L-type Ca Channels open                                                                                               | Voltage Gated Fast Na Channels Open                            |
|                    |                                                                                                                       |                                                                |
|                    | Ca Influx                                                                                                             | Na Influx                                                      |
+--------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Phase 1**        |                                                                                                                       | Peak Potential +20mV                                           |
|                    |                                                                                                                       |                                                                |
|                    |                                                                                                                       | Fast Na channels close                                         |
|                    |                                                                                                                       |                                                                |
|                    |                                                                                                                       | Transient K channels open → K Efflux and small repolarisation  |
+--------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Phase 2**        |                                                                                                                       | -10mV                                                          |
|                    |                                                                                                                       |                                                                |
| **Plateau**        |                                                                                                                       | L-Type Ca C handles open                                       |
|                    |                                                                                                                       |                                                                |
|                    |                                                                                                                       | Outward K Rectifier Channels open                              |
|                    |                                                                                                                       |                                                                |
|                    |                                                                                                                       | Balance between inward Ca and Outward K                        |
+--------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Phase 3**        | Peak Potential +20mV                                                                                                  | L-Type Channels close                                          |
|                    |                                                                                                                       |                                                                |
| Repolarisation     | L- Type Ca Channels close                                                                                             | Outward rectifier K remain open                                |
|                    |                                                                                                                       |                                                                |
|                    | K Channels Open                                                                                                       |                                                                |
+--------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
| **Phase 4**        | RMP -65 to -45Mv                                                                                                      | RMP -90mV                                                      |
|                    |                                                                                                                       |                                                                |
| **Resting State ** | A steady influx of Na+/K+ which gradually depolarises the cell.                                                       | Stable reasoning state maintained by Na/K ATPase pump          |
|                    |                                                                                                                       |                                                                |
|                    | Sympathetic stimulation increases the funny current, increasing the rate of depolarisation.                           |                                                                |
|                    |                                                                                                                       |                                                                |
|                    | Parasympathetic stimulation increases K+ permeability, hyperpolarising the cell and flattens the gradient of phase 4. |                                                                |
+--------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------+
